name: AP Physics C: Mechanics
note: Unit and topic structure follows the College Board AP Physics C: Mechanics course framework (2024 revision). Titles and descriptions are written in Scorpio's own words; they are not College Board text.

units.title: Kinematics
units.summary: Motion in one, two and three dimensions using derivatives and integrals.

topics.title: Scalars and vectors
topics.summary: Vector components, unit vectors and vector addition.

topics.title: Displacement, velocity and acceleration
topics.summary: Velocity and acceleration as derivatives of position; position and velocity as integrals.

topics.title: Representing motion
topics.summary: Graphs, equations and calculus relations for constant and changing acceleration.

topics.title: Reference frames and relative motion
topics.summary: Velocities measured by observers who move relative to each other.

topics.title: Motion in two or three dimensions
topics.summary: Projectile motion and vector kinematics with independent components.

units.title: Force and translational dynamics
units.summary: Newton's laws for systems, including friction, springs, drag and circular motion.

topics.title: Systems and center of mass
topics.summary: Choosing a system and finding its center of mass, including by integration.

topics.title: Forces and free-body diagrams
topics.summary: Identifying interactions and drawing the forces on one object.

topics.title: Newton's third law
topics.summary: Paired forces between interacting objects and internal forces in a system.

topics.title: Newton's first law
topics.summary: Balanced forces, equilibrium and inertial reference frames.

topics.title: Newton's second law
topics.summary: Net force and acceleration of a system's center of mass.

topics.title: Gravitational force
topics.summary: Universal gravitation, gravitational field and weight near and far from a planet.

topics.title: Kinetic and static friction
topics.summary: Friction models, coefficients and the limit of static friction.

topics.title: Spring forces
topics.summary: Hooke's law and springs in series and parallel.

topics.title: Resistive forces
topics.summary: Velocity-dependent drag, differential equations of motion and terminal velocity.

topics.title: Circular motion
topics.summary: Centripetal acceleration, banked curves, vertical circles and orbits.

units.title: Work, energy and power
units.summary: Work as an integral, potential energy functions, conservation of energy and power.

topics.title: Translational kinetic energy
topics.summary: Kinetic energy of a moving object and how it depends on speed.

topics.title: Work
topics.summary: Work as the integral of force over displacement and the work-energy theorem.

topics.title: Potential energy
topics.summary: Conservative forces, potential energy functions and force as the negative slope of U(x).

topics.title: Conservation of energy
topics.summary: Tracking energy in systems with and without nonconservative forces.

topics.title: Power
topics.summary: Rate of energy transfer, including P = F dot v.

units.title: Linear momentum
units.summary: Momentum, impulse as an integral, conservation of momentum and collisions.

topics.title: Linear momentum
topics.summary: Momentum as a vector for objects and systems.

topics.title: Change in momentum and impulse
topics.summary: Impulse as the integral of force over time and the area under a force-time graph.

topics.title: Conservation of linear momentum
topics.summary: Isolated systems, center-of-mass velocity and explosions.

topics.title: Elastic and inelastic collisions
topics.summary: What is conserved in each kind of collision, in one and two dimensions.

units.title: Torque and rotational dynamics
units.summary: Rotational kinematics, torque, rotational inertia by integration and Newton's second law for rotation.

topics.title: Rotational kinematics
topics.summary: Angular position, velocity and acceleration with calculus relations.

topics.title: Connecting linear and rotational motion
topics.summary: Relating tangential and angular quantities for points on a rotating object.

topics.title: Torque
topics.summary: Torque as a cross product: lever arm, line of action and direction.

topics.title: Rotational inertia
topics.summary: Moment of inertia for point masses and extended objects by integration; the parallel-axis theorem.

topics.title: Rotational equilibrium and Newton's first law in rotational form
topics.summary: Balanced torques and static equilibrium of extended objects.

topics.title: Newton's second law in rotational form
topics.summary: Net torque and angular acceleration, alone and combined with translation.

units.title: Energy and momentum of rotating systems
units.summary: Rotational kinetic energy, angular momentum and its conservation, rolling and orbits.

topics.title: Rotational kinetic energy
topics.summary: Energy of rotation and total kinetic energy of an object that also translates.

topics.title: Torque and work
topics.summary: Work done by a torque through an angle and rotational power.

topics.title: Angular momentum and angular impulse
topics.summary: Angular momentum of particles and rigid bodies, and how torque over time changes it.

topics.title: Conservation of angular momentum
topics.summary: Systems with no net external torque: changing shape, collisions with rotating objects.

topics.title: Rolling
topics.summary: Rolling with and without slipping, and the role of friction.

topics.title: Motion of orbiting satellites
topics.summary: Energy and angular momentum in circular and elliptical orbits; escape speed.

units.title: Oscillations
units.summary: Simple harmonic motion from its differential equation, energy, and pendulums.

topics.title: Defining simple harmonic motion (SHM)
topics.summary: Restoring force proportional to displacement and the equation of motion it gives.

topics.title: Frequency and period of SHM
topics.summary: What sets the period of a mass on a spring and of other oscillators.

topics.title: Representing and analysing SHM
topics.summary: Sinusoidal position, velocity and acceleration, phase and amplitude.

topics.title: Energy of simple harmonic oscillators
topics.summary: Exchange between kinetic and potential energy over a cycle.

topics.title: Simple and physical pendulums
topics.summary: Small-angle motion, and the period of an extended object swinging about a pivot.
